title: mine evidence to extend ADDR_GENERIC for France
headline: ADDR_CANON_FR already covers the dominant French street-type vocabulary; the unhandled mass is only 45,443 token occurrences over 1,694,445 France test rows (0.0268/row). FR_REGIONS is adequate (missing-department bound = 0.336% of France rows). The one NEW defect is NOT a missing entry: LEET at normalize.py:256 corrupts French ordinal suffixes, destroying 1,111 CONFIRMED France name-token occurrences (20.9% of the 5,307 France name tokens containing a digit), plus 1,943 ambiguous occurrences of '4l'.

new_defect.mechanism: _name_tokens applies LEET to any token containing both a letter and a digit. French ordinal suffixes match that shape and are transliterated into non-words: 1er->ler, 3eme->eeme, 3e->ee, 1ere->lere, 7eme->teme.
new_defect.ambiguous_note: 4l -> al via LEET. Largest digit-bearing France name token, but NOT a standard French ordinal suffix and the profile cannot say what it is. Marked SPECULATIVE and EXCLUDED from the confirmed subtotal. If ordinal-like the true figure is 3054 (57.5%); if genuine leetspeak the figure is 1111 (20.9%). Both are reported; the confirmed figure is 1111. Resolving it needs the raw business_name values, which were not read (gap G5).
new_defect.compounding_factor: LEET omits digits 2 and 9, so 2eme and 2bis survive intact today. Any future LEET edit adding 2/9 without an ordinal guard would newly break the 697 2eme and 196 2bis address tokens.
new_defect.fix: Guard, do not extend: skip translate(LEET) when the token matches ^\d+(er|ere|eme|e)$

denominators.train_note: train_s1.json has no France key in by_country or addr_tokens; countries present are US,India. France is test-only, so there is no French ground truth for learning abbreviations.

already_checked_corroboration.refuted_2_region_claim: CONFIRMED the re-scoping, independently. test_s1 France is 259452/1694445 = 15.31% of French rows, so any s1-only rate is not a France-wide rate. I do not restate the 100% figure and make no France-wide state-resolution claim (gap G2). My 0.336% is a dictionary-gap bound, a strictly different and weaker quantity.
already_checked_corroboration.additional_independent_evidence: F6 shows test_s1 uses region names (Hauts-de-France, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Pays de la Loire) while test_s2/s3 additionally use department names (Nord, Gironde, Pas-de-Calais, Loire-Atlantique) at volume. The strings being matched are not the same across sources, which is independent evidence that the s1-only figure cannot be extrapolated.

canon_table_state.derivation: parsed normalize.py:153-214 directly, then applied the normalize.py:321 France override

street_type_candidates.note: accent-free words only, due to gap G1. Field: addr_tokens.France, summed over test_s1+s2+s3.
street_type_candidates.already_mapped_verdict: every French street-type word above rank 3,000 in the data is already in the table; negative result reported as such

missing_ranked.caveat: UPPER BOUND; mixes Cit. abbreviation with Cite accent fragments (G1)
rond alone is a fragment risk

aggregate_impact.verdict: marginal gain, not a fix. No single candidate exceeds 5580.

street_type_candidates.not_a_gap: fbg and fg are defined at ADDR_CANON_FR:205 but the token fbg is absent from the France top-4000, i.e. the data spells out 'faubourg' (3046). The abbreviation is defined and unused.

abbreviation_pairs.verdict: no material extension needed; all 14 high-frequency pairs already collapsed
abbreviation_pairs.unhandled_note: all three already appear in street_type_candidates.missing_ranked; all are small

leetspeak_address_side.finding: normalize_address (normalize.py:314-353) NEVER calls LEET; only _name_tokens does (normalize.py:279-280). The France address digit-tokens are therefore untouched BY DESIGN and are legitimate French forms, not leetspeak.
leetspeak_address_side.recommendation: DO NOT add a leet pass to normalize_address - it would corrupt these

region_table.verdict: no meaningful change needed; FR_REGIONS is not the bottleneck
region_table.method: min() over component word counts, because a department only resolves if all its words co-occur; sum() would overstate
region_table.interpretation: even a perfect complete French department table would touch at most ~0.34% of France rows by this measure
region_table.unboundable_reason: at least one component word is absent from the top-4000 (TOPN=4000, build_profile.py:27) or was pruned as a hapax (prune(), line 45). NOT estimated.

source_vocabulary_split.note: test_s1 uses region names; test_s2/s3 additionally use department names at volume. Both spellings are already in FR_REGIONS so both resolve. Independent evidence that the s1-only figure cannot be extrapolated.

gaps.G1: build_profile.py:28 uses TOKEN_RE=[a-z0-9]+ on ba.lower() WITHOUT accent stripping, while normalize.py:317 calls strip_accents first. Accented French words are emitted as fragments: allee 17779 vs all 61298; cite 2546 vs cit 5580; chaussee 1125 vs chauss 2372; residence 4748 vs sidence 1467; general 4826 vs n 106424; ecole 1560 vs cole 505; chateau 1640 vs te 857. Handled by quoting only accent-free candidates. The cit=5580 figure is an UPPER BOUND. Same class as D081's finding.
gaps.G2: The profile records no component or row-level co-occurrence (build_profile.py splits on ADDR_SPLIT at line 126 and discards grouping), so a France-wide state-resolution rate CANNOT be computed. I neither reproduce nor contest the re-scoped 71.10% ceiling and make no France-wide rate claim.
gaps.G3: Departments whose component words fall outside the top-4000 are unbounded; not estimated.
gaps.G4: normalize.py:342 strips apostrophes before splitting (l'herblain -> single token lherblain) but the profiler splits on them, emitting l=99889 and herblain=44846 separately; lherblain is absent from the top-4000. The 1-2 char profile tail is 4,264,808 occurrences (35.6% of retained) and is largely artifact; must not be mined for dictionary entries.
gaps.G5: The token 4l (1943 occurrences) cannot be classified from the profile. It is corrupted by LEET either way, but whether that is damage or a correct repair depends on the raw business_name value, which was not read. Not estimated.
gaps.G6: No raw *.tsv opened. All figures come from the six profile JSONs and normalize.py:109-256.

recommendations.action: Guard LEET against French ordinals in _name_tokens (normalize.py:279-280): skip translate(LEET) when the token matches ^\d+(er|ere|eme|e)$
recommendations.expected_effect: restores 1111 confirmed France name-token occurrences (20.9% of the digit-token mass), plus up to 1943 more if 4l proves ordinal-like (G5)
recommendations.note: must land together with or before any LEET digit-map change, since adding 2/9 would newly break 2eme (697) and 2bis (196)

recommendations.action: Add clearly-safe street types: appt/appart->apt, parc, passage/pass, domaine, chaussee, sentier, venelle, esplanade, parvis, hameau, portail, halle, plage, jardin, immeuble, allees->allee
recommendations.expected_effect: ~30000 occurrences, ~0.018 per France row; marginal, cheap, low-risk
unquantified until the cit/Cite fragment contamination in G1 is resolved against raw data

recommendations.action: Add 9 missing departments to FR_REGIONS: maine et loire->pdl, val de marne->idf, val d oise->idf, marne->idf, haute garonne->naq, haut rhin, bas rhin, moselle, orne
recommendations.expected_effect: <=0.336% of France rows; upper bound. Completeness only, not score. haut rhin/bas rhin/moselle/orne would introduce NEW canonical values = schema change, review separately.

explicitly_not_recommended: DO NOT add a leet pass to normalize_address: would corrupt cour2 (3872) and chem1 (1102). CONFIRMED no-change.
DO NOT expand abbreviation tables further: all 14 high-frequency pairs already collapsed.
DO NOT mine the 1-2 char profile token tail for dictionary entries: 35.6% of retained occurrences are apostrophe/accent fragments.
DO NOT treat s1 region-token counts as France-wide.
tooling_followup: Re-run build_profile.py with strip_accents applied before TOKEN_RE and preserve component grouping. This removes G1 and G4 and makes future France token counts directly pipeline-representative. Highest-value change to the analysis tooling.
